verdict.rationale: A community-quoted Ollama log line shows the product's own diagnostic output naming the cause of the fallback (AMD GPU detected, no compatible ROCm library found) and stating that it is falling back to CPU. That is direct evidence of reason-specific fallback messaging, but it is a single log excerpt with no first-party documentation of the diagnostics. missing for 10: first-party docs on GPU-detection and fallback diagnostics, evidence the reason is surfaced beyond server logs (e.g. in the CLI or API), coverage of other GPU backends (CUDA, Metal) and failure modes, independent corroboration that the output is consistently clear

support.subject: As a power-user, I know why GPU acceleration failed and silently fell back to CPU through clear diagnostic output

citations.quote: amdgpu detected, but no compatible rocm library found... unable to verify rocm library, will use cpu: no suitable rocm found, falling back to CPU.
